image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a forest floor featuring two distinct fungal subjects. The primary subject on the right is a cream-colored coral fungus (Ramaria or Clavulina species) with multiple upright, branched structures emerging from the leaf litter. To the left, a yellowish, spindly fungal structure is partially visible but out of focus. The background consists of dark soil, decaying leaves, twigs, and small green plants.
